a.title: Microsoft’s massive Outlook outage continues

b.lede: Microsoft's day-long outage began with Outlook and Teams, and ended up taking much of the company's cloud services offline. Microsoft says it's gradually restoring service.
b.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full blown global cloud crisis
